final_message:
The bug has been fixed. The issue was in the `wrap` function's condition for when to break a line. The original code used `len(cur) + extra > width - 1`, which incorrectly forced line breaks even when words could fit exactly at the end of a line. 

The fix changes the condition to `len(cur) + len(w) + 1 > width`, which properly checks if adding a word (including the required space before it) would exceed the specified line width. This ensures that "aaa bbb" with length 7 fits exactly in a width of 7, rather than forcing a break and resulting in three separate lines.
